name: German Solo
summary: 4-player plain-trick bidding game where declarer picks trumps and tries to win 5 of 8 tricks alone or with a hidden ace-partner.
rules_text: Play with 32 cards, German or French suits. Top trumps are permanent matadors: Spadille (Ober/Queen of Acorns/Clubs), Manille (trump 7), and Baste (Ober/Queen of Leaves/Spades), followed by Ace high to 7 low, with matadors not counting as their natural suit. Deal 8 cards each 3-2-3 clockwise. Bidding in order: Frage (partner game, call a plain ace you don't hold; holder is secret partner), Grossfrage (must be bid if you hold Spadille+Manille unless you go Solo; partner is revealed and chooses trumps), Solo (declarer alone). Acorn contracts outrank others. If all pass, holder of Spadille must play Mussfrage. Declarer names trump except Grossfrage where partner does. Trick play as whist: lead any card, follow suit if able, highest trump or highest led suit wins. Declarer's side needs 5 tricks; may stop after 5 for prime bonus or try for all 8 (Tout/Durchmarsch).
